## Lightspeed Hero (CR 15)

Half-elf samurai 1 (warrior poet)/unchained monk 11/champion 6  
NG Medium humanoid (elf, human)/outsider (native)  
**Init** +10 (amazing initiative); Senses low-light vision, Perception +22  


**Defense**


**AC** 33, touch 29, flat-footed 28 (+1 deflection, +4 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 monk, +4 natural, +5 Wis, +4 Cha)  
**hp** 101 (11d10+1+30)  
**Fort** +9, Ref +11, Will +10. +2 racial vs. enchantment spells and effects  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, force of will, hard to kill, improved evasion, mythic saves, purity of body, recuperation, resolve 1/day, still mind, to the death; Immune sleep  


**Offense**


**Speed** 116 ft.(+10 exodus of speed, +30 fast movement, +5 fleet, +11 favored class bonus [elf ], +30 impossible speed)  
**Melee** +2 ki intensifying katana +19/+14/+9 (1d8+6, 18-20) or unarmed strike +16/+11/+6 (2d6+3)  
**Ranged** masterwork shuriken +17/+12/+7 (1d2+4), earthfire shurikenP50NoFS +17/+12 (1d2+5)  
**Special Attacks** burst through, fleet charge, fleet warrior, flurry of blows (+2 attacks), ki strike (cold iron, lawful, magic, silver), mythic power 15/day, skirmisher’s challenge 1/day (+1 dodge to AC, +1 insight on saves), stunning fist 12/day (DC 24), style strike (defensive spin, spin kick) (1/round), surge +1d8  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, Dex 18, Con 10, Int 12, Wis 21, Cha 18  
**Base Atk** +12, CMB +16, CMD 35  
Traits Charming, Enlightened Warrior  
**Feats** Agile Maneuvers, Azata Style, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Fleet, Mobility, Planar Heritage (aasimar), Psychic Sensitivity, Improved Unarmed Strike, Run<sup>M</sup>, Spring Attack, Stunning Fist<sup>M</sup> , Weapon Finesse<sup>M</sup> , Weapon Focus (katana)  
**Skills** Acrobatics +19/+56/+63, Diplomacy +19/+20, Escape Artist +19, Perception +22, Sense Motive +20  
**Languages** Celestial, Common, Elven  
**SQ** dual minded, flourish (exodus of speed), *ki* pool (10 points), ki powers (abundant step, ki hurricane, snatch arrows, sudden speed), mythic ki, order (order of the eastern star), seven-league leapMO  
**Gear** amulet of natural armor +4 (32,000 gp), boots of striding and springing (5,500 gp), elixir of tumbling 250 gp), 2 earthfire shurikenP50NoFS (800 gp), headband of mental superiority +2 (16,000 gp), +2 ki intensifying katana (32,350 gp), monk’s kit (8 gp), monk’s robe (13,000 gp), 2 potions of cure serious wounds (1,500 gp), quick runner’s shirt (1,000 gp), ring of ferocious action (3,500 gp), ring of protection +1 (2,000 gp), 5 masterwork shuriken (31 gp), 61 gp
